first.rationale: We face two concurrent headwinds: competitive price pressure on SMB and declining activation metrics. Memory_73 directly addresses the competitive threat—targeted promotional pricing has proven effective for price-sensitive SMB segments with acquisition lift and improved time-to-first-value. Memory_57 and memory_86 confirm that revenue quality and activation remain strong when pricing is deployed tactically. Verifying memory_31 and memory_73 will confirm whether combining simplified onboarding with promotional pricing is the right pairing, or if promotional pricing alone should carry the week. However, given the immediate competitive threat and the explicit success of promotional pricing against SMB price sensitivity, promotional_pricing is the higher-ROI experiment. This preserves our option to tackle activation decline next week if needed, and avoids cannibalizing our qualified revenue base by discounting broadly. A standard_experiment scope balances speed-to-signal against risk in a contested segment.
